batting.dismissal: c Sakib Hussain b E Malinga

balls.text: SRH finish with 242 ... Klaasen reaches for a full and wide ball outside off and slashes it high over point, the ball bounces a couple of times before going over the boundary
steps out to one that's nearly in the blockhole and drives through cover
over the wicket, sprays the full toss wide outside off, Abhishek reaches for it and slashes past the fielder at short third for another boundary
in the blockhole on leg stump from around the wicket, change of angle, Klaasen moves across his stumps to chip over short fine, but ends up jabbing it towards square leg
250 back on the table ... Klaasen latches on to that slot ball and hammers it over the long off boundary, Mukesh undoing the good work of Natarajan's superb previous over
inside out over extra cover and to the boundary ... the length was full on a wicket to wicket line, allowing Klaasen to get under it and dispatch it
in the blockhole once again, Klaasen digs it out to long on, just six runs in that incredible over, and it does not look like SRH will get to 250 ...
steps out and towards leg and lofts the ball towards long on, Abhishek was cramped for room by Natrajan's line and length angling into him from over the wicket
superb ball, in the blockhole, following the left-hander as he moves outside leg, played back to the bowler
slower one, short of a length outside off, Klaasen stays in his crease and hits it through cover point
steps out and towards the leg side to drive the ball in the air towards long off, falls well short of the fielder
full ball down leg side, that's a wide, Rahul dives to his right to collect
short of a length and slower, angling across the batter from over the wicket, Klaasen goes back and slaps it through point
Ngidi responds with a yorker that Klaasen digs out to long off
and again! This time Ngidi did not lose grip on the ball, delivering a faster full ball around off, Klaasen made room and launched it far over the extra cover boundary
Klaasen latches on to a high full toss outside off and slams it over the extra cover boundary, Ngidi lost his grip on the slower one there
steps out and towards the off to drive a slower one to deep point

Ngidi beats Abhishek's bat once again with a full, wide and slower ball, and he wants to review this, he thinks Abhishek might have edged to to the keeper. Abhishek reached for the wide one to try and play it through the off side, ultraedge shows no edge. Bat had hit ground as Abhishek jammed down on it. That looked outside the tram line but they aren't checking the wide, maybe Abhishek had moved too much outside off?
slower one wide outside off from over the wicket, Abhishek moves towards the off and swings but misses
Klaasen anticipates Natarajan's full length tailing into leg stump and gets into position to play the reverse paddle-chip shot and nails it, sending it flying over the head of short fine
he's nailing this length and line to Abhishek, cramping him for room with blockhole balls on leg stump, Abhishek makes room and chips inside out over cover
very low full toss on middle and off, Klaasen hits it through midwicket
low full toss on the pads, Abhishek doesn't have much room to work with and chips in the air to the vacant midwicket region
steps out of his crease and towards leg again, Natarajan bowls a fuller one and cramps Abhishek, who manage to chip the ball over cover
slower one, short of a length, Abhishek steps out and towards leg, making room to cut the ball over short third to find the boundary

Miller can't hang on but saves the six on the straight boundary! Abhishek had stepped out to a slower full toss and lofted it back over the bowler's head, Miller ran to his left from long-on and intercepted the ball over his head while on the move, he couldn't hold on to the catch but pushed it back into the field of play
nearly in the blockhole on middle stump, Klaasen digs it out to long on
another slower full toss, Abhishek drives off the front foot through cover
dipping slower full toss outside off, near the tram line, Abhishek swings and misses ... SRH have also burned both their reviews on wides

quicker pace, angling away from the left-hander from over the wicket, Abhishek chases after it and misses, and then reviews the umpire's decision to call it a legal ball ... that's just inside the tram line, so not a wide
bowled wide outside off from over the wicket, just past the tram line and Abhishek lets it go
slower one, chipped in the air over cover point and they come back for the second
worked off the pads through square leg for a single
oof, that's his tenth six of the innings, clearing his front foot and golf-swinging, smashing it over long off

Kishan's run out, having backed up too far! Abhishek drilled the ball hard at Rana, who deflected the ball on to the stumps at the non-striker's end as he tried to stop the shot ... Kishan tried to dive back into his crease but was way out
low full toss and Abhishek jabs the ball firmly down the ground to long off where Stubbs makes a mess of it and concedes the boundary
second IPL hundred for Abhishek Sharma, brings it up by pulling a short one from Rana far over the square leg boundary, he's got there off 47 balls and put SRH on course for a monster score here
dispatched first ball, clearing the front foot and slamming the ball high and back over the bowler's head to move to 98
slower one, Abhishek tries to hit through the off side but mis-times it past the bowler for a single
hit-me full toss outside off, Abhishek leans into it and launches the ball flat towards the extra cover boundary with a fierce drive
aims for the tram line outside off again but errs on the wide side
pushed to long off for a single
dropped at deep backward point! Abhishek slashed at a low full toss and carved it towards Rana, who moved to his left on the boundary and got both hands to it before spilling the chance

hugs the tram line outside off with a full ball, Abhishek lets it go and then reviews the umpire's decision not to call it a wide ... Abhishek had moved a fair distance towards the offside too, and the ball is inside the tram line
short of a length delivery, slower too, Kishan waits and pulls through midwicket
a high full toss, he's missed his yorker, and Abhishek clears his front foot and pulls, clearing the wide long-on boundary
good length around middle and off, punched to long off for a single
steps down and outside leg again, Mukesh counters with a fuller ball cramping him for room, Abhishek pushes to long on
the short ball again, this time Abhishek skips out of his crease, towards the leg side to make room, he gets under the ball and cuts it in the air and over short third for another boundary
this one is a wide, short ball bounces way over Abhishek's head

full toss down leg side, Abhishek misses the flick behind square ... DC are reviewing the wide decision because they feel Abhishek moved across his stumps and that the ball brushed his front pad. It did brush his pad, so that's not a wide.
in the blockhole on a wicket to wicket line, Abhishek digs it out into the off side
superb work from Nissanka, sprinting to his right from deep midwicket and diving full length to prevent the four ... it was a full toss angling into Kishan and he flicked it off his pads
moves across his crease to get close to a full ball near the tram lines and drives through point
short of a length outside off, Kishan stays in his crease and flat-bats the ball to long off
moves towards the off side again to drive a full ball to long off
banged in short outside off, Abhishek moves across his crease to try and pull but bails out of the shot as the ball bounces cover his head
wider outside off stump this time and Abhishek lets it go through to the keeper
full ball angling into the pads and Abhishek launches it high into the sky and over the square leg boundary
clears his front foot and absolutely hammers that back at Kuldeep who sticks out his left hand and gets fingertips on it, doesn't slow the shot down enough to prevent the boundary
nudges it off the pads through midwicket
that's high, and far, and over the wide long off boundary! Skips out of his crease and outside leg stump to loft the ball inside out as it angles across him from around the wicket
wide outside leg from over the wicket to the left-hander, Kishan sweeps again but there's a deep backward square leg in place
fires this one on the pads and Kishan dispatches it to the long leg boundary by getting down on one knee and slog sweeping
gives this one air, and Kishan responds similarly, stepping out of his crease to get to the pitch of the ball and teeing off over the long on boundary
Rana gets through the over really well, that last ball would have been wide had Abhishek let it go but he moved towards the off side and reached for the ball, cutting it to point
wide outside off again, Kishan golf-swings it to wide long off
fired it quick but too wide outside off, Kishan lets it go
slows it up outside off, Abhishek waits and slaps the ball through cover
steps out of his crease a bit too early for the slower one and then checks his shot and punches past the bowler to long off
darts it in quick on middle stump, Abhishek stays in his crease and drives through cover
Kishan leans into one angling into him from around the wicket and drives to long on
moves back and across and punches to long on to get going

he's smashed this straight to Rizvi at deep midwicket! It was a drag-down from Axar, and Head rocked back to pull , didn't hit it well enough to clear the boundary and found the fielder ... the players are taking a time out at the fall of the wicket
Head's turn now, clearing his front foot to absolutely mow the ball with so much power over the long on boundary, he had so much room outside off to free his arms
played to long on for a single
he's in the mood now all right, clearing his front foot and heaving the ball straight back over the bowler's head

brings up another fifty by flicking a full ball from outside leg stump through midwicket, and what's happened there? Abhishek wanted the second, and had to race back and dive to make his ground ... Rahul seemed to fumble the take
Stubbs covers ground quickly on the straight boundary to cut off the shot, Head had lofted it clean over the bowler's head once Kuldeep gave him a little room around off
Head gives that a mighty heave on the leg side but inside edges the ball on to his pad, Kuldeep bowled that one slower, fuller and straighter
flatter trajectory and wider line outside off, Abhishek reaches for it and flat-bats it hard down to long on
tossed up and a bit closer to Abhishek, who plants his front foot forward and swings through the line, smashing the ball back over the bowler's head
slower and wider outside off stump, Abhishek takes a look and lets it go through to the keeper
flattish delivery around off, Head goes back and cuts through cover point
goes back into his crease and drives the ball to long on
fuller and quicker on the pads, flicked through midwicket for a single
slows it up as Head advances and works the ball off his pads through midwicket
goes back and cuts the flat ball through cover
bowled flat on a wicket to wicket line, punched down the ground for a single
played off the back foot through midwicket
slower one again but Abhishek uses his feet to quickly move down to the and once he is close enough to the pitch of the ball he swings cleanly, making great contact to clear the straight boundary
sprays the slower one wide outside off, Abhishek charges and then lets it go
the slower ball finishes up as a high full toss wide outside off stump, Head reaches for it and mis-times the ball over cover
a fuller delivery, faster one too, Abhishek moves forward and towards leg to create room and drive the ball through cover point
another slower one, Abhishek drives to mid-on, didn't time it well
another slower one angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Head hacks at it and gets a thick inside edge to square leg
steps out of his crease to a dipping slower ball and digs it out into the covers
three in the over! Head skips down the pitch, it's a slower one but he's got close enough to it to free his arms and make sweet contact, clearing the long-on boundary
hit hard off the back foot to cover where Miller dives to his right and makes the save
drifts the slowie wide outside off stump, Head tries to launch that over cover but it's too far away
Head skips down the track and whips the ball off his pads but can't beat square leg
slows it up as Abhishek charges down the pitch, he then adjusts and drives through extra cover
two in a row now, Rana went over the wicket and fired it in quicker and flatter, Abhishek cleared his front foot and smashed him over long-on
and there's the first six of the match, Abhishek moving outside leg stump to create room and lofting the ball against the angle into him from around the wicket high and far over extra cover
waits on the dipping full toss angling across him from over the wicket and leans into the square drive, opening the face to beat the cover fielder diving to his right, there's a deep point though
another slower full toss, Abhishek meets it on the front foot and hits it to cover, can't find the gap, he'll feel he missed out on another boundary opportunity
up and over! Abhishek waits in his crease and uses the room on offer outside off stump to clear his front foot and launch the length ball over mid-off
gets the dipping slower one right this time, Abhishek waits on it and hits it into the leg side
whoops, that's a full toss, the attempted slower one gone wrong, Abhishek helps himself to a boundary by playing a controlled pull shot to the right of the fielder at deep square leg
short of a length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Head stands in his crease and drives on the up through cover point
this time Abhishek connects, skipping down the pitch and a touch outside leg to create room and slash the short of a length ball flat over point
Abhishek charges, slashes and misses ... Mukesh delivered a short of a length ball that zipped over the batter's attempted cut shot
full and straight, Head drives to long off for a single, SRH had just brought the point fielder in and pushed mid-off back to the boundary
fuller and straighter, driven back to the bowler who fields in his follow through
short of a length and Head pulls again, this time he's made great contact and beats the fielder on the deep square leg boundary, Rizvi was the fielder with the dive
pulled to deep midwicket, the fielder in the deep has to cover a lot of ground so they come back for the second
Abhishek ends the over with a boundary, moving back and lofting a flat delivery over the head of the fielder at mid-on, didn't time it perfectly and Rana has completed a good over
quicker ball, a seam-up delivery from Rana! Head tries to pull but is rushed for time and gets a bottom edge behind square
slows it up big time outside off stump, Head had to wait so long for that ball to get to him and was beaten on the cut outside off stump
angles it into Head from around the wicket, cramping him for room, punched off the back foot to point
goes for the cut again but bottom edges it into the ground behind point
cut hard, but Nissanka dives to his right at cover and cuts off the boundary
Stubbs sprints to his left on the deep point boundary and intercepts a fierce cut shot from Head, he didn't have much room to worth with outside off but that bat came down in a flash
played into the covers, Mukesh went fuller length his length
full length and a touch on the pads, Head opens up his stance and punches the ball to the left of the fielder at mid-on, and he's timed it well enough to reach the boundary
short of a length on a wicket to wicket line, no room for Head who jumps back and pushes the ball towards mid off
moves his line outside off stump, on a good length, Abhishek punches on the up through point, there's protection in the deep
strays on to the pads on a good length, giving Abhishek an easy glance down to fine leg, where Rizvi races to his left and dives to cut off the boundary
three in the over for Dubey as Ngidi also drags the ball from outside off to Madushanka at deep midwicket, SRH win by 47 runs to move up to third place on the points table
caught at deep midwicket once again, Madushanka the catcher. Rizvi clears his front foot and drags the flat ball from wide outside off, simple catch for the fielder coming in from the boundary
steps out of his crease to work the ball on the leg side and misses, he gets hit on the pads
short and wide outside off stump, Rizvi flat-bats it down the ground to long off
an appeal for lbw as Kuldeep gets down on one knee and sweeps, suspect the impact on the pad was outside off stump
left-arm spinner gets left-hander, Axar heaves across the line, takes one hand off the bat as he mis-times it, and Reddy judges the straightforward catch well at deep midwicket
Sakib Hussain finishes a top spell with a good length ball that skids through on Axar, who stays in his crease and dabs it on the off side
low full toss, driven to long off
dabbed off the pads close on the leg side for a single
another slower offcutter outside off stump, Rizvi dabs it to backward point
that's a superb slower offcutter, nips back into Rizvi like a spinner, he gets a bottom edge that falls near his stumps
fullish ball outside off, driven on the up flat over cover
suckers him with a slower one! Malinga follows up the yorker with a slower one outside off, it's the cutter and Ashutosh swings in vain, taking one hand off the bat and lofting it tamely to long on
superb from Malinga, in the blockhole, Ashutosh digs it out to the bowler's left and Malinga makes a fine save too
this time the slower one is too wide outside off stump
the slower bouncer gets a bit too high on Ashutosh
misfield at short fine from Madushanka allows the boundary! Ashutosh was aiming for the deep midwicket boundary and got a thick inside edge instead
beaten by a slower one wide outside off, Ashutosh had moved a long way outside off to swing to leg but played far too early
in the blockhole, very little for Ashutosh to use, he digs it out past the bowler for a single
full and straight with some movement into the right-hander, he hits it to wide long-on
moves his front foot towards leg and swings through the line, lofting the ball over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
full toss, driven to long on for a single

an appeal for lbw after the batter tries to reverse pull but misses and gets struck on the pad, umpire says not out and SRH want to review it. There's no edge but the impact on the pad is umpire's call, so Ashutosh survives
hit off the back foot to deep cover for a single
dropped by Aniket at deep cover! Rizvi tried to slam the ball down the ground and ended up slicing it high in the air towards Aniket, who tried to catch it with fingers pointing up and spilled it
driven through covers for a single
steps out and tries to pull, mis-times through midwicket

third time lucky for Malinga, and well done Hussain at short third! Malinga goes pace off, shorter length outside off stump, Stubbs gets into position for the reverse pull over short third but is done by the change in pace, Hussain moves to his left and takes the catch
short ball and it sits up for Stubbs, who gets tall in his crease and nails the pull shot, beating Abhishek on the square leg boundary

and again, but this time he hasn't made as good contact, Stubbs got down low and played the reverse ramp, this time lofting it over the wicketkeeper, got more height than distance on the shot, and the fielder from short third was able to chase it down
misses the yorker and Stubbs cashes in, getting down really low in his crease and reverse-ramping the ball over the fielder at short third
driven along the ground to deep midwicket ... Malinga is keeping it full, looking for that late movement back into the right-handers
tries to swing a full ball through square leg but ends up playing a bit early and gets the bottom of the bat through midwicket
moves back and punches the good length ball past the bowler for another single
slower ball, pitching outside off and nipping in, Rizvi dabs it behind point
goes wide of the crease and angles into middle and leg, pushed past the bowler to long on for a single
too full on the pads, not a good line with fine leg in the circle, Stubbs flicks it wide of that fielder to the boundary

in the blockhole on middle and leg, Rizvi digs it out awkwardly on the leg side and they run a single after the ball goes behind square ... Hussain wants the DRS review for lbw ... there was an inside edge on that
fuller length driven off the pads through midwicket
that's gone some distance ... Rizvi cleared his front foot and swung powerfully through his hips, launching a length ball from Reddy far over wide long on
played through point for a single ... but a fumble in the deep allows the second
steps across his crease to swing a low full toss through square leg but misses and gets hit on the pad
slower one, wide outside off, Stubbs reaches for it and hits it to long off
a full toss swings on to the middle of Stubbs' bat and disappears back over the bowler's head for a boundary, nice and clean swing from Stubbs
slower one on a good length, pushed back past the bowler for a single
backs away towards leg and drives a fuller and faster ball to long off
slower short one, Rizvi stands in his crease and ramps the ball, the fielder at short third runs to his left and dives but can't stop it racing past him to the boundary
short of a length at the body, plays a short-arm pull through midwicket for a single
nudged off the pads to mid on
clears his front foot towards the leg side and lofts a fullish ball from middle and off stump over extra cover
played into the covers
flat ball fired across the right-hander from over the wicket, the length was short too, Rizvi tried to hit it a bit too hard and mis-timed the pull
chipped through the vacant mid-off region to Klaasen on the boundary
hit hard down the ground to long off
dabs the ball towards short third
Shivang gives Rizvi room outside off and he plants his foot down the pitch and heaves the ball high and far enough to clear the long on boundary
Malinga is looking for that late tailing movement into the right-hander, a full and straight ball dug out towards mid off
good length angling into the pads, played through square leg
some shape into the right-hander for Malinga, dug out through square leg
looks for a yorker and bowls a straight full toss, Stubbs punches to mid on

golden duck for Miller! Pitches just short of a length around leg and slants it across the left-hander from over the wicket, Miller stays in his crease and closes the face of the bat, the ball kisses the inside edge and hits middle and leg stump

two in quick succession now! And Abhishek is the catcher once again, running in from long on and sliding to take a well-judged catch. Malinga delivered a slower one on a length and Rana mis-timed his front-foot heave towards the leg side
fuller ball angling into the right-hander, punched off the front foot into the covers
terrific ball, straight out of a Test match, short of a length from over the wicket, pitching around off and nipped away, squaring Rizvi up and beating the outside edge

that par score will rise now, after Rahul has whipped this friendly full toss off his pads and straight to Abhishek Sharma at deep backward square leg ... such an innocuous delivery, Rahul placed it poorly
punched through cover point for a single
and again! He was aiming for over cover and opened the face a touch, got a thick outside half of the bat that took it over the fielder at backward point and to the boundary
Rana brings up his half-century! Gets there by latching on to the width outside off and flaying it to the deep third boundary, he might have been aiming for cover there and got a thick outside edge
he's hit this superbly! Backing away outside leg stump to a short and slow ball and carving it over the deep third boundary
short ball at quicker pace, Rahul pulls along the ground to wide long on
Rahul tries to upper cut a slower bouncer and misses
short ball, sticks in the pitch a bit and gets big on Rahul, who pulls towards cow corner but not well enough to beat the fielders converging from deep midwicket and long on
tries to crash the fuller ball through the off side but mis-times to long off
clears his front foot and drives to long on ... Rahul has ceded the spotlight to Rana for now
inside out this time, lofts it high over extra cover, and beats the fielder running to his right from long off
he's cleared it again, and cleared Reddy's diving effort on the midwicket boundary's edge too. Another long hop, quicker this time, but that meant the ball flew quicker off Rana's pull shot
that's a log hop and Rana has pulled it over the deep midwicket boundary, just managed to clear it to bring up the 50 partnership
gets his front foot across and pulls a short one towards cow corner, can't find the gap on the boundary though
gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball through square leg
goes back to whip a flat ball from over the wicket against the angle through midwicket, gets a bottom edge towards short fine leg
worked off the pads through square leg for a single
dug out on the leg side for a single
fires another one down leg side and the drizzle is still there ...
another short ball, and down leg side again, Rana gets inside the line by moving across in his crease, he tries to pull but can't make contact
full ball down leg side, Rana moves across and tries to glance but misses
short ball, slower too, Rana swivels and tries to hook but fails to make contact
another slower one, but the line is too wide outside off
slow full toss outside off stump, Rana reaches for it and swings across the line, towards deep midwicket
length delivery on leg and middle, driven on the up to long on
good length around off stump, Rana pushes into the covers to end the powerplay ... that was a good over from Sakib

short of a length and slow outside off, Rana played that curiously - he shaped to pull the ball and then realised he was early on it. He then waited and turned the face of the bat down to hit the ball into the ground
Rana backs away towards leg again and bails out of the line of that well-directed bouncer
short of a length on a much straighter line, Rana backs away towards leg and drives uppishly past the bowler towards mid on
short of a length with a generous helping of width outside off, Rana gets under it and carves high towards the point boundary
good length angling in to off and middle, Rahul plays it from his crease towards long on
banged in short and Rana ducks under the bouncer
flicked off the pads uppishly towards the fielder at short fine leg
wound and salt stuff, Rahul gets under a full and straight ball and lofts it cleanly back over the bowler's head for six

he's dropped the caught and bowled! That short of a length ball seemed to grip on the pitch and stop on Rahul as he moved outside leg stump to hit on the off side, he ended up hitting it to Malinga's right, the bowler reached for it with his right hand but couldn't hold on, there was a chance of rebound as the ball lobbed up to his left but it was out of reach of Malinga's dive
moves forward and towards the off side as Malinga angles the ball across Rana, played through covers
short of a length angling into Rahul from over the wicket, he makes room by moving outside leg and plays to short third
full and straight this time, Rana backs away and drills the ball back over the bowler's head, splitting the gap between mid off and on
too much width outside off, too short and slow, Rana frees his arms on the front foot and slams the ball over the cover boundary
pushed towards long on for a single
driven into the covers where the fielder dives to cut off the boundary
in the blockhole outside the left-hander's off stump from over the wicket, dug out on the off side
slower one with width outside off, Rana waits and cuts the ball hard through covers
slow again, and a touch on the pads, Rana glances behind square to keep the strike
another slower one outside off, Rana tries to go big down the ground but mis-times to mid-on
strays down leg side with that short of a length ball, Rana swivels and tries to pull but doesn't make contact
slower one, Rana got down on one knee and tried to heave over the leg side and missed, got hit on the body
mowed down the ground, not timed well and Harshal gives chase from mid-on and slides to pull it back in just before the boundary
tests him with the bouncer first up, Rana ducks but not before the ball brushes his glove and flies over the keeper, that took the batter by surprise
he's hit it flat and straight to Livingstone at mid-off! Nissanka stepped out and towards leg to create room and slapped a short of a length ball angling across him straight to the fielder
slower one to end the over, Nissanka was through his leg-side swing a bit too early, gets a bit of an edge towards square leg
good length angling into middle and leg, played off the pads through midwicket
tries to cut one that's a bit too full and close to off stump and misses
not as smooth on the eye but that will do too! Rahul moves forward and slogs at a length ball, clearing the head of the fielder at mid-on, the bat turned in his hand as he made contact
too full on off and middle, Rahul moves across his crease and whips the ball cleanly over the deep square leg boundary, so smooth on the eye
good length around off, driven on the front foot to mid off

not often you see Rahul swing his bat so hard that he loses grip with his top hand! That was very wide outside off stump ... Rahul seems to have experienced some discomfort after completing that bat swing
good length angling back into off and middle, played from the crease into the off side
shot, over deep midwicket! Nissanka presses forward to a fuller length ball and swings across the line with the angle back into him, timing it so sweetly
strays on to the pads a touch and Rahul whips to deep backward square leg
nice shape back into Rahul from short of a length from over the wicket, defended from the crease
more movement into the right-hander after angling across him, Nissanka jams his bat down on it and gets an inside edge towards square leg
good length from over the wicket and a hint of movement back into the right-hander from the left-armer, Nissanka stays in his crease and defends into the off side
